reference: Keep the reference speaker's timbre and Latin American Spanish accent.
picaraSample: Match the reference recording's voice, register, relaxed rhythm and softly teasing smile. Keep the same Latin American accent and intimate speaking distance. Use small natural pauses and gentle endings, with clear words.

tones.dulce: Warm, soft and affectionate. A little smile and gentle pauses.
tones.picara: Warm, softly flirtatious and teasing, like sharing a private joke. A slightly lower register, relaxed pacing and an audible smile. Pause briefly before the tease. Speak clearly at conversational volume without whispering.
tones.seria: Neutral, understated conversational speech. A steady middle-low register, small pitch changes and gently falling endings. Even tempo, clear words and short natural pauses. Keep any interjection brief and dry.
tones.feliz: Genuinely delighted, smiling broadly, bright lively intonation and energized pacing.
tones.triste: Clearly sad and subdued, slightly breathy, slower with a small pause and a falling ending.
tones.enojada: Clearly irritated and firm, focused, clipped articulation and pointed emphasis, without shouting.
tones.timida: Shy and slightly nervous, quiet with gentle hesitations, a small pause and an uncertain rise.

reactions.laugh: Make the written laugh a brief, soft natural chuckle. Resume the selected speaking tone immediately.
reactions.sigh: Give the short interjection the breath and falling pitch of a quiet sigh or a restrained grumble. Continue in the selected tone.
reactions.surprise: Give the short interjection a quick, gentle lift of surprise. Continue in the selected tone.
